snapshot_mode: 0400 exclusive regular files; no-follow logical paths
scope: Manifested project replay only. No open arithmetic obligation is supplied.
dependency_provenance_scope: Declared package anchors and direct cached dependency objects are identified. No transitive artifact census, dependency checkout pin/cleanliness claim, source replay, or object-to-source provenance is asserted by this driver.

relocation_path_adapter.scope: Physical process locations only; preserved manifest and receipt identities remain exact.

current_runtime_profile_binding.scope: Current source observation/permission; fresh native qualification is required separately.

source_adjacent_asset_policy.subject_directories: Recursive non-Lean files, excluding repository/.noeaaeue/cache/state directories as before.
source_adjacent_asset_policy.umbrella_scope: Immediate non-Lean regular root files only; subdirectories retain their source/input/.noeaaeue/evidence/cache roles.

report.limit: Explicit path bans and subject-root checks are a structural lower bound; mathematical subject review is required.

pending_taxonomy_proposal.authority: Taxonomy evolution deferred to grwtsk/noeaaeue by the human owner.

report.scope: Present Git tracked plus nonignored untracked Lean sources, partitioned into active role-bearing sources and exact candidate-only evidence; deleted tracked regular files are reported separately. No ignored archives, builds, or native execution.

shared_math_layout_gate.scope: Complete Git tracked and nonignored untracked source inventory; this is distinct from the manifested proof scope.
